store.title: Store details
store.description: Used for email footers and default sender details.
store.addressPlaceholder: e.g. 88 Caoxi North Rd, Xuhui, Shanghai, China
store.addressHelp: Shown in the footer of every marketing email. Enter a real postal address where recipients can reach you (street, number, city, country). Do not enter an email, phone number, or placeholder text.
store.savedAddressInvalid: The saved footer address failed validation: {problem}. Until fixed, marketing email footers will still show it as-is.
store.contactAdminToFix: Contact a workspace admin to fix it.
store.saveFailed: Failed to save. Your input is kept—please try again.
store.adminOnlyHint: Only admins can update workspace settings.
store.whyAddressTrigger: Why is a physical address required?
store.whyAddressTitle: Why is a physical mailing address required?
store.whyAddressDescription: Anti-spam regulations (such as CAN-SPAM) require marketing emails to include a valid physical postal address in the footer. This address appears at the bottom of every marketing email and can be an office, store, or P.O. box—not an email address, phone number, or placeholder.

profile.placeholder: e.g. Anna Chen or Canvas Studio Team
profile.help: Used as the email sign-off ('{{sender_name}}' in templates) and shown in the team list and activity logs. Use a name or brand your contacts recognize. Applies to newly created or edited campaigns without changing existing ones.
